stalled.relay_failed: Could not reach any peer-discovery relay. Check this device is online. Dohhh needs one brief handshake through public infrastructure before it can talk device-to-device.
stalled.lost_connection: Lost the connection to the other device. Still trying to reconnect automatically - if this does not clear up, check you are both still online and on the same network.
stalled.nobody_here: Still nobody else here. The usual causes: the others have not opened the game yet, they typed a different code, or you are on networks that will not let devices talk directly - mobile data especially. Getting everyone onto the same Wi-Fi fixes it.

storage_degraded: Nothing is saving right now - private browsing or storage being blocked, most likely. Reloading this tab will lose your place in the game.

qr.drawing_error: Could not draw the QR code. Read the four words out instead.
qr.point_camera: Point your camera at the other phone's code.
qr.no_camera: This device has no camera the browser can use.
qr.https_required: Browsers only allow camera access over HTTPS (or on localhost). Use the four-word code instead.
